title: finding(components,security): `data-table`'s client-side search and sort run over a masked column's RAW values, so a substring search or a sort order recovers a credential the cell draws as `••••••`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a · security). A column the table withholds on copy, tooltip, export and edit still answers questions about its raw value. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the round-1 contract review of PR objectui#10643 (objectui#10583). The review read it at source, and the dev recorded it with no carrier. PR objectui#10643's docs, JSDoc, zod `describe()`, README and changeset now name it as NOT covered. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (the PR objectui#10643 reviewer's reading at its round-1 head `6bad2d4ff`; ⛔ not re-read by the seat)

`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`:
- client search (~:1179-1189) and client sort (~:1207-1218) read the raw row value of every column, masked ones included;
- `autoSizedWidths` (~:955-960) sizes a column from its raw values (min 80, max 400), which is a trivial length oracle.

## Reach (the reviewer's reading)

Client search and sort run wherever the table searches and sorts on the client: `ObjectGrid` inline data, or `manualSearch` off. There, a substring search recovers a credential character by character, and a sort by the masked column orders rows by the secret.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Once PR objectui#10643 lands, the table reads the declared `TableColumn.masked` flag. It is the one authority, and the rule is not restated in `components`. Then decide per path: leave a masked column out of the client search predicate; refuse or disable sorting on it; size it from the drawn mask, not the raw value. Pin each path with a `text` control. ⛔ Serial: this depends on PR objectui#10643 merging first.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (740 items), titles matched against `mask|password|secret|search.*sort|oracle`: no hit on this defect. The regex walk over the 1000 most recently updated items, `search.*masked|masked.*search|oracle`, gives no hit on it either.

Dedupe words: `masked column search oracle` · `data-table sort password raw` · `client search secret substring` · `autoSizedWidths raw length`
